task: Migrate OpenCode agents, commands, agent-review skill, MCP servers and permissions to Claude Code

commits.subject: chore: mirror OpenCode agent setup for Claude Code
commits.author: Denys Kozlov

logicalChanges.reason: Port .opencode/agents to Claude Code subagents so both harnesses share the same roles
logicalChanges.expectedBehavior: architect/reviewer run on opus with read-only tools; rails/tester/integration/retro on sonnet; bodies identical to the OpenCode agents
limitations: The contracts router is not a subagent: Claude subagents cannot spawn subagents, so the role lives in CLAUDE.md

logicalChanges.reason: Port the 9 .opencode/commands to Claude Code skills invoked as /<name>
logicalChanges.expectedBehavior: /issue reads civora-org/civora-platform issues via gh; publish-pr, update-review and retro are user-invoked only (disable-model-invocation)

logicalChanges.entity: agent-review skill, MCP servers and journaling hook
logicalChanges.reason: Expose the agent_review_* tools to Claude Code via the agent-review MCP server and replace the OpenCode plugin hooks with a PostToolUse hook; carry over slov-lex and playwright MCP servers
logicalChanges.expectedBehavior: Tools appear as mcp__agent-review__agent_review_*; Edit/Write/Bash calls are journaled to .agent-review/events.jsonl only while a session is active
limitations: Absolute machine paths in .mcp.json (same as opencode.jsonc)
Hook assumes agent-review is a sibling checkout
logicalChanges.evidence: agent-review npm test: 70/70 pass incl. MCP listTools + hook mapping; stdio smoke call agent_review_status returned status inactive

logicalChanges.expectedBehavior: git status/diff/log allowed; branch/commit/push/pull/docker compose/web ask; git reset/clean, rm, docker system prune, db drop/reset denied
limitations: edit:ask not mirrored as a hard rule; governed by permission mode plus AGENTS.md approval gates

logicalChanges.reason: Load AGENTS.md as shared source of truth in Claude Code and define the main session as the contracts router
logicalChanges.expectedBehavior: CLAUDE.md imports @AGENTS.md; AGENTS.md lists the Claude Code mirror to keep in sync

Decidim::ContractsSk::Admin::AmendmentForm
  accepts a complete amendment form
  rejects a blank summary
  rejects a missing summary
  caps the summary at 255 characters

Decidim::ContractsSk::Admin::AuditEventsController
  inherits from the engine's admin base controller
  implements exactly the index action (read-only viewer)
  does not sit on the engine's public base controller chain
  pins the audit action vocabulary actually written by the commands
  derives the six lifecycle-action keys from the transition table, never hand-enumerated

Decidim::ContractsSk::Admin::ContractForm
  accepts dotted decimal strings
  accepts proper numerics without the string guard (spec/API compatibility)
  accepts the decimal(12,2) ceiling itself
  accepts a nil amount (the value may be unknown while drafting)
  rejects non-numeric strings instead of letting the cast zero them
  rejects comma decimals (the Slovak '12,50' habit, caught deliberately)
  rejects scientific notation (the format guard stays strict)
  rejects negative amounts
  rejects amounts beyond the decimal(12,2) column's ceiling
  rejects over-ceiling strings too (raw input, same cap)

Decidim::ContractsSk::Admin::ContractsController
  inherits from the engine's admin base controller
  implements exactly the CRUD + transition + CRZ-handoff + import + redaction actions (no show, no destroy)
  does not sit on the engine's public base controller chain

Decidim::ContractsSk::Admin::DocumentForm
  accepts a complete form
  defaults the kind to the model's column default
  accepts every kind of the form's editor vocabulary
  narrows the mod
